info.title: Meshy API
info.description:
The Meshy API lets you programmatically generate 3D models, textures, images, and character rigs/animations.
Scope: this specification covers the core generation, post-processing, printing and account endpoints. The Creative Lab APIs (keychain, fridge magnet, figure, vinyl figure, brick figure, lamp, keycap, collapsible fidget, fidget pixel) and the Text to Motion API are documented only on their pages at https://docs.meshy.ai/api/creative-lab-keychain and https://docs.meshy.ai/api/text-to-motion (see https://docs.meshy.ai/llms.txt for the full index); they are not part of this file.
**Authentication.** All requests require an API key sent as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer msy_YOUR_API_KEY`. Create keys at https://www.meshy.ai/settings/api.
**Asynchronous model.** Generation endpoints do not return the result directly. A `POST` creates a task and returns `202 Accepted` with a task ID in `result`. Retrieve the outcome by polling `GET .../{id}` until `status` is terminal (`SUCCEEDED` / `FAILED` / `CANCELED`), or by connecting to the `GET .../{id}/stream` Server-Sent Events endpoint.
**Base URL.** `https://api.meshy.ai/openapi`. This document is served at https://docs.meshy.ai/openapi.yaml (and `.json`); the human-readable reference lives at https://docs.meshy.ai.
**Scope.** This specification covers the generally-available public endpoints. Endpoints still in development, partner-specific surfaces (creative-lab, d5), and legacy `/v1`,`/v2` path aliases are intentionally omitted.

post.description: Creates a Text to 3D task. Use `mode: preview` to generate geometry, then `mode: refine` (with `preview_task_id`) to texture it; or omit `mode` and set `should_texture: true` for a single fused geometry+texture call. The `202` body additively includes the universal task object alongside `result`. Consumes credits (varies by model and options); see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Provide exactly one of `image_url` or `input_task_id`. Consumes credits (varies by model and options); see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Provide 1-4 images of the same object via `image_urls`, or reuse a prior task's images via `input_task_id`. Only Meshy 5 and newer are supported. Consumes credits (varies by model and options); see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (a GLB). Provide exactly one style source: `text_style_prompt`, `image_style_url`, or `multiview_image_urls`. Consumes credits (varies by model and resolution); see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url`. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.

post.description: Convert a model to one or more formats. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url`; `target_formats` is required. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url`, and at least one of `resize_height`, `resize_longest_side`, or `auto_size`. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Generate a UV layout for a GLB. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (a GLB). Availability is limited; high-poly inputs must be remeshed first. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Rig a model with a skeleton. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (a GLB). Models above 320,000 faces are rejected; remesh to a `target_polycount` of 300,000 or less first. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Apply a library animation to a rigged model. `rig_task_id` must reference a completed Rigging task. See the Animation Library for valid `action_id` values. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.

get.description: Return every preset action that can be applied via `action_id`, each with an animated GIF preview. Free; consumes no credits. The whole library comes back in one response rather than paginated, so a single call can populate a picker.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on `name` or `key`. Matched literally, so `%` and `_` are ordinary characters rather than wildcards.

parameters.name: sub_category
parameters.description: Exact match on `sub_category`. Accepted on its own; sub-category names are not unique across categories.

parameters.name: action_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated `action_id` values to return, at most 200. Ids that no animation carries are absent from the response.

200.description: The animation library.

post.description: Generate a multi-color 3MF for color 3D printing. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (GLB or FBX). Availability is limited. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task. On success, `model_urls.3mf` holds the result.

post.description: Split the Meshy 6 / Meshy 7 model of a prior task into separately printable parts — automatically, by named parts, or by color region — with optional connectors (thin regions are always reinforced). The result is untextured: the cut rebuilds the surfaces and drops any input texture. Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.

The task. On success, `model_urls` holds one URL per requested format, `part_count` the number of printable parts. Auto Split tasks omit the generation-prompt fields, `model_url` and `texture_urls`, which they never populate.

post.description: Repair a model for printing; the repaired asset is returned in the input format. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (GLB, glTF, OBJ, FBX, or STL). Consumes credits; see https://docs.meshy.ai for pricing.

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

post.description: Analyze a model's printability (watertightness, manifold edges, holes, etc.). Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (GLB, glTF, OBJ, FBX, or STL). This endpoint is free (no credits).

200.description: A page of tasks, newest first by default.
The task.

get.description: Returns the total available credit balance for the API key's account.

200.description: The current balance.

get.description: Returns one page of the team's API tasks with the credits each one consumed, newest first by default. Requires an API key belonging to a Studio or Enterprise team. Records cover tasks that have reached a terminal status; with no explicit time range the window is the last 30 days.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort key; `created_at` is the only sortable column.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the `created_at` window, RFC 3339. Defaults to 30 days before `end_time`. The window may span at most 1 year.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the `created_at` window, RFC 3339. Defaults to the current time.

parameters.name: endpoints
parameters.description: Comma-separated endpoint names to include, using the same values the `endpoint` response field carries (e.g. `image-to-3d,animate`). Omit to include every endpoint; an unknown name is rejected with 400.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by terminal task status. Omit to include both.

200.description: A page of usage records, newest first by default.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Send your API key as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer msy_YOUR_API_KEY`. Keys are created at https://www.meshy.ai/settings/api and have the form `msy_<random>`.

SortBy.name: sort_by
SortBy.description: Sort key; a leading `-` sorts descending (e.g. `-created_at`). The sortable columns depend on the endpoint.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per second on the caller's tier.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current second.

XRateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the request budget is full again.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Sent with a request-rate 429.

PollRetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before polling again. Sent while the task is PENDING or IN_PROGRESS.

TaskStream.description: A Server-Sent Events stream. Each `message` event's `data` is a JSON task object of the same shape returned by the corresponding `GET .../{id}`, emitted as the task progresses until a terminal status.

Forbidden.description: The API key's team plan does not include this endpoint, or the key has no team.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or the feature is not available to this account).

Conflict.description: The resource exists but its current state does not allow the operation. Returned when deleting a task that is already IN_PROGRESS: credits for work the worker has started are not refundable, so the task is left running rather than deleted for nothing. Retry once the task reaches SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELED.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request was well-formed but could not be processed (e.g. pose estimation failed).

Error.description: Standard error body for the public API.

CreateTaskResponse.description: Returned with `202 Accepted` when a task is created. `result` is the new task ID. (On `POST /v2/text-to-3d` the body additively includes the full universal task object alongside `result`.)

ModelURLs.description: Download URLs for the generated model, keyed by format. Only produced formats are present.

TextureURL.description: A set of PBR texture map URLs.

enable_tsr.description: Fast-mode TSR option (only meaningful with turbo).

optimize_texture_seams.description: Fast-mode texture-seam optimization (only meaningful with turbo).

TextTo3DRequest.description: Text to 3D request. `prompt` is required when `mode: preview` (or for a one-call textured task). `preview_task_id` is required when `mode: refine`.

mode.description: Phase. `preview` generates geometry; `refine` textures a preview. Omit and set `should_texture: true` for a single fused call.

prompt.description: Text description of the object. Required for preview / fused tasks.

preview_task_id.description: Parent preview task ID. Required when mode=refine.

ai_model.description: Model to use. `latest` resolves server-side to `meshy-7.1`. `meshy-7`, `meshy-7.1`, and `meshy-t2` require account entitlement. `meshy-7` is deprecated, superseded by `meshy-7.1` (same parameters, same cost). The aliases `meshy-standard-latest` and `meshy-smart-topology-latest` are also accepted and normalized server-side. The `latest` default applies to `mode: preview` and to fused single-call tasks; on `mode: refine`, omitting this inherits the preview task's model instead.

model_type.description: Pipeline. `smart-topology` implies the meshy-t2 model family. `lowpoly` is deprecated and will be retired on 2026-10-30; after that date it returns an error. Use `smart-topology` (Meshy T2) instead.

topology.description: Output mesh topology. `quad` is not supported for meshy-t2.

target_polycount.description: Target polygon count. Defaults to 30000 (meshy-t2 uses a smaller model-specific default).

should_remesh.description: Remesh after the draft stage. Default depends on model.

should_texture.description: One-call textured path (requires account entitlement; ignored otherwise).

pose_mode.description: Force a rest pose for characters.

origin_at.description: Where to place the model origin.

count.description: Number of candidates to generate. Not supported for meshy-t2 or fused tasks.

model_id.description: Optional client-supplied identifier for batch requests.

texture_resolution.description: Texture resolution tier. Only valid when mode=refine.

geometry_resolution.description: Geometry detail tier, preview stage only. `2k` is equivalent to the deprecated `ultra_mode: true`. Requires `meshy-7.1` or `latest`. Either Ultra tier adds 5 credits and requires account entitlement.

alpha_thumbnail.description: Opt in to a transparent-background preview.

ImageTo3DRequest.description: Image to 3D request. Provide exactly one of `image_url` or `input_task_id`.

image_url.description: Input image as an http(s) URL or a data URI.

input_task_id.description: Reuse the input image from a prior task.

ai_model.description: Model to use. `latest` resolves to `meshy-7.1`. `meshy-t2` requires `model_type: smart-topology`. `meshy-7` and `meshy-7.1` require account entitlement. `meshy-7` is deprecated, superseded by `meshy-7.1` (same parameters, same cost).

model_type.description: Pipeline selector. `lowpoly` is deprecated and will be retired on 2026-10-30; after that date it returns an error. Use `smart-topology` (Meshy T2) instead.

topology.description: Output mesh topology. `quad` is not supported for meshy-t2.

target_polycount.description: Target polygon count. Defaults to 30000 (meshy-t2 uses a smaller default).

should_remesh.description: Remesh after the draft stage. Default depends on model.

geometry_resolution.description: Geometry detail tier. `2k` is equivalent to the deprecated `ultra_mode: true`. Requires `meshy-7.1` or `latest`. Either Ultra tier adds 5 credits and requires account entitlement.

image_enhancement.description: Enhance the input image. Not supported under smart-topology.

remove_lighting.description: Remove baked lighting. Not supported under smart-topology.

pose_mode.description: Force a rest pose for characters.

origin_at.description: Where to place the model origin.

alpha_thumbnail.description: Opt in to a transparent-background preview.

MultiImageTo3DRequest.description: Multi-image to 3D request. Provide 1-4 images of one object via `image_urls`, or reuse a prior task via `input_task_id`.

input_task_id.description: Reuse images from a prior task.

ai_model.description: Model to use. Meshy 5 and newer only. `latest` resolves to `meshy-7.1`. `meshy-7` is deprecated, superseded by `meshy-7.1` (same parameters, same cost).

geometry_resolution.description: Geometry detail tier. `2k` is equivalent to the deprecated `ultra_mode: true` and adds 5 credits (requires entitlement). Requires `meshy-7.1` or `latest`.

should_remesh.description: Remesh after the draft stage. Default depends on model.

texture_prompt.description: Texture description. Mutually exclusive with texture_image_url(s).

texture_image_url.description: Single texture reference. Mutually exclusive with texture_prompt and texture_image_urls.

texture_image_urls.description: 1-4 texture reference views (primary first). Requires should_texture and an effective Meshy 7 model. Mutually exclusive with texture_image_url/texture_prompt.

pose_mode.description: Force a rest pose for characters.

origin_at.description: Where to place the model origin.

alpha_thumbnail.description: Opt in to a transparent-background preview.

RetextureRequest.description: Retexture request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (a GLB), and exactly one style source: `text_style_prompt`, `image_style_url`, or `multiview_image_urls`.

model_url.description: GLB as an http(s) URL or data URI.

text_style_prompt.description: Text style description. Mutually exclusive with multiview_image_urls.

image_style_url.description: Style reference image. Mutually exclusive with multiview_image_urls.

multiview_image_urls.description: 1-4 views of the same object (primary first). Requires an explicit `ai_model: meshy-7` (with entitlement). Mutually exclusive with the prompt/style-image inputs.

alpha_thumbnail.description: Opt in to a transparent-background preview.

RemeshRequest.description: Remesh request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url`.

model_url.description: Model as an http(s) URL or data URI.

resize_height.description: Target height (meters). Mutually exclusive with resize_longest_side and auto_size.

resize_longest_side.description: Target longest side (meters). Mutually exclusive with the other sizing options.

auto_size.description: Auto-estimate real-world size. Mutually exclusive with resize_height.

origin_at.description: Where to place the model origin.

convert_format_only.description: Only re-export formats (no remesh). When true, sizing/topology/polycount are ignored.

alpha_thumbnail.description: Opt in to a transparent-background preview.

ConvertRequest.description: Convert request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url`. `target_formats` is required.

model_url.description: Model as an http(s) URL or data URI.

ResizeRequest.description: Resize request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url`, and at least one of `resize_height`, `resize_longest_side`, or `auto_size`.

model_url.description: Model as an http(s) URL or data URI.

resize_height.description: Target height (meters). Mutually exclusive with auto_size.

resize_longest_side.description: Target longest side (meters). Mutually exclusive with the other sizing options.

origin_at.description: Where to place the model origin.

UvUnwrapRequest.description: UV Unwrap request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (a GLB).

model_url.description: GLB as an http(s) URL or data URI.

RiggingRequest.description: Rigging request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (a GLB).

AnimationRequest.description: Animation request. Applies library animation(s) to a rigged model. Provide exactly one of `action_id` or `action_ids`.

action_id.description: Animation to apply. Valid IDs are data-driven; see the Animation Library at https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/animation-library.

action_ids.description: Several animations to apply at once, returned as a single file with one clip per action, in the order given here. Costs 3 credits per action. Valid IDs are data-driven; see the Animation Library at https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/animation-library.

post_process.description: Optional post-processing. Applies to the merged file when action_ids is used.

generate_multi_view.description: Produce a 4-view split image instead of a single image.

pose_mode.description: Force a rest pose (may upgrade the model and require a higher tier).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Supported values depend on the model (GPT Image models: 1:1,16:9,9:16,4:3,3:4,3:2,2:3; nano-banana family: 1:1,16:9,9:16,4:3,3:4). Cannot be combined with generate_multi_view.

remove_background.description: Return a transparent RGBA cutout (single-image only).

ImageToImageRequest.description: Image to Image request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `reference_image_urls`; if both are sent, `input_task_id` wins.

input_task_id.description: SUCCEEDED Text to Image / Image to Image task (multi-view included) of yours whose output images become the reference images. ALL of its images are used, so a multi-view source fills several of the 5 slots. Mutually exclusive with reference_image_urls.

reference_image_urls.description: 1-5 reference images to edit from. Mutually exclusive with input_task_id.

generate_multi_view.description: Produce a 4-view split image instead of a single image.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio (model-dependent; cannot be combined with generate_multi_view).

remove_background.description: Return a transparent RGBA cutout (single-image only).

PrintMultiColorRequest.description: Multi-Color Print request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (GLB or FBX).

input_task_id.description: Prior task whose GLB to use.

model_url.description: GLB/FBX as an http(s) URL or data URI.

printer_brand.description: Printer brand whose slicer preset (default printer, 0.4 mm nozzle) is written into the 3MF.

PrintSplitRequest.description: Auto Split request. `input_task_id` must be a succeeded image-to-3d, multi-image-to-3d, text-to-3d (preview), remesh, convert or resize task whose model was generated with Meshy 6 or Meshy 7. A textured input is accepted; the split rebuilds the cut surfaces, so the result is always untextured.

input_task_id.description: Prior task whose model to split. A textured model is accepted and its texture is not carried into the result.

mode.description: auto lets Meshy choose the cuts; by_parts / by_color cut along the parts or color regions named in `prompt`.

prompt.description: Names the parts to split into (1-10); naming a single part leaves the unnamed remainder as its own part. Required for by_parts / by_color; ignored for auto. A description that asks for no split or names more than 10 parts is rejected with 400 and not charged; one Meshy cannot read at all falls back to auto and the task reports prompt_ignored: true.

target_formats.description: Export formats. Formats that support scene objects carry each part as a separate object; stl fuses all parts into one solid.

layout.description: Arrangement baked into every output format: assembled keeps the source pose; on_plate lays the parts flat and spread on the build plate.

connectors.description: Add mortise-and-tenon connectors at each cut.

connector_type.description: Connector shape (only when connectors is true).

connector_size.description: Connector size relative to the cut surface (only when connectors is true).

connector_height.description: Connector height relative to the cut surface (only when connectors is true).

PrintRepairRequest.description: Print Repair request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (GLB, glTF, OBJ, FBX, or STL). At most one of intended_print_height_mm and intended_print_longest_side_mm.

input_task_id.description: Prior task whose model to repair.

model_url.description: Model as an http(s) URL or data URI.

alpha_thumbnail.description: Opt in to a transparent-background preview.

printer_type.description: Printer that sets the minimum wall thickness for the size-aware check. fdm when a print size is sent without it, unless an analyze task passed as input_task_id supplies the printer.

intended_print_height_mm.description: Planned print height in millimeters, rounded to a whole mm. GLB input only (a .glb model_url or any input_task_id). Mutually exclusive with intended_print_longest_side_mm.

intended_print_longest_side_mm.description: Planned print longest side in millimeters, rounded to a whole mm. Mutually exclusive with intended_print_height_mm.

PrintAnalyzeRequest.description: Printability Analysis request. Provide exactly one of `input_task_id` or `model_url` (GLB, glTF, OBJ, FBX, or STL). At most one of intended_print_height_mm and intended_print_longest_side_mm.

model_url.description: Model as an http(s) URL or data URI.

printer_type.description: Printer that sets the minimum wall thickness for the size-aware check. fdm when a print size is sent without it.

intended_print_height_mm.description: Planned print height in millimeters, rounded to a whole mm. GLB input only (a .glb model_url or any input_task_id). Mutually exclusive with intended_print_longest_side_mm.

intended_print_longest_side_mm.description: Planned print longest side in millimeters, rounded to a whole mm. Mutually exclusive with intended_print_height_mm.

Task.description: A generation task (image-to-3d, multi-image-to-3d, retexture, remesh, convert, resize, uv-unwrap, print/multi-color, print/repair, print/split). Prompt/style fields are echoes of the request and are empty for modes that do not use them.

started_at.description: Start time (epoch ms; 0 if not started).

finished_at.description: Finish time (epoch ms; 0 if not finished).

geometry_resolution.description: Echoed Ultra tier (2k or 4k); omitted when the task did not run an Ultra tier.

prompt_ignored.description: True when a by_parts / by_color print/split prompt named no parts and Meshy split the model automatically instead; present from PENDING on. Omitted for auto tasks, when the prompt was followed, and for other task types.

part_count.description: Number of printable parts a print/split produced; formats that support scene objects carry one object per part, stl fuses them into one solid. Degenerate slivers are removed before export and not counted. Omitted for other task types.

intended_print.description: print/repair only: the print a size-aware repair ran for (sent, or inherited from a size-aware analyze task); present from PENDING on. Omitted otherwise.

print_repair_report.description: print/repair only: what a size-aware repair did; present once it has succeeded.

IntendedPrint.description: The print a size-aware check or repair ran for, in millimeters. Every key is always present.

height_mm.description: Print height when sized by height; otherwise null.

longest_side_mm.description: Print longest side; null until measured for a height request.

dimensions_mm.description: [width, depth, height] at this size. GLB input only; null otherwise and until measured.

PrintRepairReport.description: Before/after record of a size-aware print repair.

route.description: thin_wall: walls thickened; topology: walls were thick enough; topology_unmeasured: walls could not be measured.

applied.description: Whether wall thickening changed the mesh (thin_wall route only).

thin_area_ratio_before.description: Fraction of the input surface thinner than the minimum wall; omitted if the input could not be measured.

thin_area_ratio_after.description: Same fraction on the repaired model; omitted if not measured.

ThinWalls.description: Wall-thickness result at the size in intended_print.

thin_area_ratio.description: Fraction of the surface thinner than the minimum wall; null if not measured.

has_thin_walls.description: True when any part of the surface is thin. Informational; use status.

status.description: error when thin_area_ratio is above 0.05; unknown when not measured.

mode.description: Legacy preview/refine phase; omitted for one-call fused tasks.

geometry_resolution.description: Echoed Ultra tier (2k or 4k); omitted when the task did not run an Ultra tier.

ImageGenerationTask.description: A Text to Image or Image to Image task.

BasicAnimations.description: Preset walk/run clips generated alongside the rig.

AnimationLibraryItem.description: One preset action in the animation library.

action_id.description: Value to pass as `action_id`. Unique and stable, but not contiguous.

name.description: Human-readable label. Not unique across animations.

key.description: Unique stable slug for the animation.

preview_url.description: Animated GIF preview of the action.

status.description: Printability verdict. For a size-aware task, the worse of the topology verdict and thin_walls.status.

UsageRecord.description: One task's usage entry: a billing row about a task, metadata only — no request bodies and no asset URLs. To fetch the task itself, pass `task_id` to the corresponding retrieve endpoint.

task_id.description: ID of the task this record bills.

endpoint.description: The endpoint the task ran on, e.g. `image-to-3d`. Text to 3D tasks report their phase.

created_at.description: Task creation time, in unix milliseconds.

finished_at.description: Completion time in unix milliseconds; null when the task carries no completion time.

consumed_credits.description: Credits consumed by this task. 0 for FAILED tasks (credits are refunded on failure).

api_key_name.description: Display name of the API key that ran the task.

api_key_suffix.description: Last four characters of that API key.
